blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Finance (DOF) is moving ahead with the mobilization of a $6.78-million grant from the Green Climate Fund (GCF) to strengthen the country’s capacity to access global climate financing. In a statement on Wednesday, the DOF said it would begin implementing the Third Readiness and Preparatory Support Program for the Philippines (RPSP3) in partnership with the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI). READ: DOF launches climate finance strategy This comes four months after the DOF had secured the grant, which will fund projects and capacity-building activities over the next five years.
